info.title: OpenCITE Scholarly Evidence API
info.description: Verifiable scholarly evidence for agents: search 250M+ open-access papers and heritage archives, fetch any work by id, and verify references before citing them. Every card names its source and carries integrity evidence (retracted / corrected / expression of concern); every response says which sources answered. Docs: https://citation.today/docs/ · llms.txt: https://citation.today/llms.txt

get.summary: One deduped, citation-ready call across 250M+ open-access papers plus museum, library, manuscript and Islamicate archives.
get.description: One deduped, citation-ready call across 250M+ open-access papers plus museum, library, manuscript and Islamicate archives. Each result names its source database, carries DOI/URL provenance, an integrity check (retracted / corrected / expression of concern, work type, OA status) and a formatted citation. The response says which sources answered. Billed 1 credit per call, prorated by the coverage actually delivered; requires an API key.

corrections.description: Correction / erratum notices [{ notice_doi, date, source }]. Empty when none.

expression_of_concern.description: Expression-of-concern notice { notice_doi, date, source } or null.

post.summary: Verify a list of references before you cite them.
post.description: Verify a list of references before you cite them. For each reference (a DOI, PMID, PMCID, or a free-text citation string) returns a verdict — verified, mismatch (the identifier is real but the supplied title/authors/year disagree), not_found (likely fabricated), ambiguous — plus the canonical record, its integrity evidence (retracted / corrected) and a corrected citation in the requested style. Up to 50 references per call; 0.1 credit per reference.
